title: GORNE'S WAY // THE LABYRINTH BENEATH THE WALL
narrative: Three leagues west of the Shadow Tower, Tormund pushed aside a curtain of frozen lichen to reveal the gaping maw of Gorne's Way: a cavernous highway descending into the bowels of the earth. Torches flickered against subterranean waterfalls and vast chasms spanning hundreds of feet. Three thousand years ago, Kings Gorne and Grendel had led their people beneath the Wall through these tunnels, only for half to lose their way forever. In the utter darkness below, blind cave-wights with milky eyes chattered their teeth, waiting for the unwary to drop from the limestone bridges into the bottomless abyss.
